answer: Each identity claims one karst sinkhole, locks an 80-credit bond, and releases a saffron dose, filing its serial. A velvet filter at the spring traps it; the auditor recomputes arrival and peak from the karst conduit table. Over 3% off, a reused serial, or a shared sinkhole burns the bond. First pays 38, kth 38+7(k-1), 1000th 7031; 1000 fakes pay 3,534,500 plus 80,000 locked. A rented-sinkhole ring fails: one sinkhole gives one curve, so a second dose duplicates it and exposes reuse, or misses the table value and burns both. An honest identity pays 38 once and reclaims it after a clean epoch.
